text: ずーッと　とり　ポケモンに　こだわって　きた　ぼくです！

structure.jp: ずーッと　とり　ポケモンに　こだわって　きた
structure.en: who has stuck with bird Pokémon all along

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ずーッと　とり　ポケモンに　こだわって　きた　ぼく
patterns.explanation: A whole phrase ending in a verb sits in front of ぼく and tells you what kind of 'me' it is. とり　ポケモンに　こだわって　きた　ぼく = 'me, who has been devoted to bird Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says something has gone on from the past up to now. こだわって　きた = 'have been devoted all this time'.
